attr.title: Lighthouse
attr.desc: Lighthouse is the HarbourMasters PC port of Banjo-Kazooie, with Anchor multiplayer, romhack and multi-language support, and a built-in randomizer.
attr.inst: Copy your Banjo-Kazooie .z64 rom to ports/lighthouse/baseroms. The rom is converted to bk.o2r on first launch, which can take a few minutes; choose No at 'Run Lighthouse?' when it finishes and the game restarts automatically.
